title: Enabling high-contrast text hides existing ink until a drawing update
repro: 1. Install supplied Release APK on emulator-5688 and launch a fresh process.
2. Draw several purple strokes and expand controls so Undo is enabled.
3. Run adb -s emulator-5688 shell settings put secure high_text_contrast_enabled 1.
4. Wait five seconds, capture, wait at least three more seconds and capture again without touching paper.
5. Tap Undo; observe the retained drawing reappears with one stroke removed. Restore the original high_text_contrast_enabled value.
expected: Existing drawing remains visible, history remains usable, and no activity is recreated while high-contrast text changes.
actual: All visible ink disappears while paper texture and chrome stay painted. Two fresh launches had 36324 and 38288 detected purple paper pixels before the change and zero afterward in both delayed captures. PID11910/create count2 and PID12582/create count3 remained unchanged within their respective runs. Undo stayed enabled and recovered 32628/34811 ink pixels. This establishes visual disappearance, not destruction of the stored in-memory stroke history.
suspectedCode: experiments/native-architecture/src/drawing/SkiaInk.tsx:324-330 (present on React layout commits) and :380 (SkiaPictureView); possible native surface invalidation without presentation after accessibility contrast changes. Attribution is a hypothesis; activity recreation was not observed, so no missing configChanges flag is implicated.
shipping: Not run. The brief supplies no shipping oracle for high-contrast-text surface redraw; no comparative behavior claimed.

additionalObservations.description: Same blank-ink/Undo recovery observed in normal configuration sweep; two fresh confirmations remain the API34 pair.
Same blank-ink/Undo recovery observed on enabling and restoring high-contrast text during one configuration round trip. Two fresh confirmations remain the API34 pair.

title: Expanded action-button icons vanish in the shortest phone split-screen pane
repro: 1. On emulator-5688 launch a fresh probe, draw a multi-stroke picture and expand controls.
2. Enter Recents, open the Splotch icon menu, choose Split screen and select Android Settings as the other app.
3. With Splotch above Settings, drag the divider from the half-screen handle toward the upper third. Verify the snapped app bounds are Rect(234,0-847,743), effective234×231dp content.
4. Wait five seconds. Inspect the expanded Undo, Save, Coloring, Stroke Width and Brush buttons.
5. Leave split screen by dragging the actual divider center y756 to the bottom; verify full-screen bounds and recovered icons.
expected: Action buttons retain visible, recognizable icons at an OS-supported split size; drawing and Undo survive entry, resize and exit.
actual: All five expanded action tiles remain as blank white rectangles in the small pane, despite Undo remaining enabled and working. Purple house remains visible. Full-screen exit recovers the icons. Reproduced in independent fresh processes PID21316/create count5 and PID23237/create count6, with no further creates across each resize.
suspectedCode: experiments/native-architecture/src/rsdDrawing/edgeLayout.ts:145-147 clamps face size to available space but derives padding from base×scale; experiments/native-architecture/src/rsdDrawing/RsdIconButton.tsx:313 subtracts unchanged padding and border from the smaller size, allowing non-positive glyph space. This is a source-supported hypothesis; no missing configChanges flag or activity recreation observed.
shipping: Not run; no shipping small-window icon behavior supplied in the brief, so no parity claim.
